name: Goddess XoXo
source:
Goddess XoXo is a slice-of-life visual novel in where the player explores the themes of love, friendship, loyalty, and morality. 

Three goddesses have accidentally found themselves on Earth and it is up to you to guide them!

[From [url=https://deddangames.itch.io/goddess-xoxo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Goddess XoXo是一款生活片段视觉小说，玩家可以在其中探索爱情、友谊、忠诚和道德等主题。

三位女神意外地发现自己来到了地球，你需要引导她们！

[来自[url=https://deddangames.itch.io/goddess-xoxo]Itch.io[/url]]
